name: Recurve Longbow
description:
Feeling weird that crossbows outrange longbows? Want a superior option for your glorious longbowmen? Then this mod is for you.

Introducing the Recurve Longbow, a high-draw-weight bow designed to suppress enemies from long range by firing arrows in a higher arc, trading accuracy for superior reach.

[list]
[*]Requires [b]Marksman 20[/b] to use due to its > 120lb draw weight.
[*]Unlocked via [b]Crossbows II[/b] research (for sake of balance).
[*]Craftable at the [b]Bowyer's Table[/b] after reaching [b]Carpentry 20[/b].
[/list]
